name: Spell capabilities
notes: Capabilities granted by knowing a spell (CONSTITUTION §4). Seeded with what the example puzzle needs and ADR-0004's fire chain, whose unlocks are src/content/data/unlock/sorcerer-fire.json (mw-e19.3).

capabilities.name: Mage Hand
capabilities.description: Manipulate distant objects: pull a lever, lift a key or drag a crate from range (CONSTITUTION §4).

capabilities.name: Ember
capabilities.description: Ignite a candle, a rope or spilled oil at a touch (ADR-0004 fire chain, step 1).

capabilities.name: Firebolt
capabilities.description: Hurl a burning projectile that sets what it hits alight (fire chain, step 2).

capabilities.name: Flame Jet
capabilities.description: Hold a cone of flame that burns through webs, cloth and crowds (fire chain, step 3).

capabilities.name: Fire Wall
capabilities.description: Raise a burning barrier that blocks a passage and scares off creatures (fire chain, step 4).
